name: Okuma Corporation
summary: Okuma Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells machine tools in Japan, the Americas, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific. The company offers multitasking machines; 5-axis vertical and horizontal machining centers, as well as 5-axis high-speed blade machine; saddle, parallel spindle, and vertical CNC lathes, as well as twin spindle turning centers and aluminum wheel applications; vertical and horizontal machining centers; double-column machining centers; CNC cylindrical and internal grinders; intelligent CNC, software, and IoT solution; and automation robot system.
